review_basis: Fresh complete source read of module declarations, constants/classes and graph-indexed function bodies. Graph imports guide boundaries, not audit verdicts. Independent second-review notes were not consulted.
scope_limits: Static source inspection only. No target imports or copied-target execution, tests, real configuration/environment values, database/model/network use, source edits or pushes.
Sensitive/domain callees remain opaque. Reading local implementation does not certify trust, source identity, evidence/admission, sanitizer completeness or domain-policy correctness.
External caller/test and standard-library source context adds zero project function coverage.
Historical verdicts and independent second-pass findings are not inherited.
Global production denominator remains 7140; this module is credited separately.
